The 20 GiB default per-cycle projection is a placeholder until measure_stage_throughput reports measured bytes/row on real 9x9 tdata.
The retention bounds 6 / 10 / 3 / 3 are design choices, not measurements.
prune_retention.py --apply has been exercised only on synthetic trees (worker's and validator's); it has never deleted real loop data.
